provenance.author: Vincent Russo
provenance.method: Galois descent over Z[i]: the four conjugates of the target under Gal(Q(zeta_16)/Q(i)) span a space of dimension min(4, m + 1); no search

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, one core; about 10 s for the certificate

llm.role: found the descent argument and wrote the certificate

notes: Settles chi(|sqrtT>) = 2 with the two-term witness. Every qubit stabilizer state is a scalar times a vector over Z[i], so the span of a decomposition is defined over Q(i) and contains every image of the target under the four automorphisms zeta -> zeta^k (k = 1, 5, 9, 13) of Q(zeta_16) fixing i; at one copy the conjugates (1, zeta^k) span C^2, so no single stabilizer state works (directly: the amplitude ratio e^{i pi/8} is not a fourth root of unity). Exact throughout: the only computation is the rank of the 2^m x 4 matrix of conjugates in Q(zeta_16), by sympy's algebraic-field arithmetic, and no floating-point margin stands under it. The same certificate prints chi(|sqrtT>^m) >= min(4, m + 1) for m <= 6.
